Myanmar assures India its territory won't be used for anti-India activities

Myanmar has assured India that its territory will not be used for any activities hostile to India. This assurance was given during the 23rd National Level Meeting on border security held in New Delhi. The talks focused on maintaining peace and security along their shared border.
